resources.string: Update widgets without opening the app or showing a permanent notification.
Select your headphones and approve the Android request. This helps widgets update while the app is closed.
On HyperOS, also allow autostart and set the battery mode to No restrictions. The system may still limit background operation. Open the app again after a force-stop.
Available on Android 12 or later if supported by your phone.
Turn on Bluetooth to set this up.
First connect supported headphones in Bluetooth settings, then refresh the list.
Background operation is not set up
Disable background operation for these headphones? They will stay paired in Bluetooth and widget settings will be kept.
Setup failed. Check Bluetooth and the Nearby devices permission. Turn on Location if Android asks, then try again.
